blocks.summary: 'I'm a single mum on £41,000 and limit my weekly shop to £40.' What do you want from the Budget? People earning from £380 a month to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they want to see in this year's Budget. 'A dream come true' - Harry Kane on his Ballon d'Or win. It's the first time an English player has lifted the trophy since Michael Owen in 2001. Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help. The chancellor will axe tariffs on some staples as part of plans to give households "breathing space".
